_comment: DO NOT EDIT: generated by go run ./cmd/egggen from internal/pcvm/catalog.json and egg/registry.json
name: PCVM Virtual Machines
author: canhphung@users.noreply.github.com
description: PCVM v2.0.0 Virtual Machines Egg: 5 checksum-verified providers with typed policy, safe lifecycle management and no telemetry.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
install -d -m 0750 /mnt/server/.pcvm
echo '[PCVM] Control directory initialized.'

variables.name: Software
variables.description: Provider ID, or interactive for the three-level console menu.

variables.name: Software Version
variables.description: Pinned upstream version or latest.

variables.name: Software Build
variables.description: Pinned build or latest.

variables.name: Runtime Version
variables.description: auto, or a supported Java, Node.js, Python, PHP, .NET, Bun, Deno, Go, Caddy or SteamCMD runtime line.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Resolve upstream on every start. Pinned-by-default is safer.

variables.name: Update Request
variables.description: Change this value to trigger one resolve/update.

variables.name: Reset Confirmation
variables.description: For incompatible switches, paste DELETE:<nonce> printed by the launcher.

variables.name: VM Memory
variables.description: Guest RAM in MB, or auto. The container must have at least 1536 MB and PCVM reserves at least 384 MB for QEMU/launcher.

variables.name: VM CPUs
variables.description: Guest vCPU count from 1 to 8, or auto. Auto uses up to 2 vCPUs on AMD64 and 1 on ARM64; explicit values cannot exceed the cgroup quota or host policy.

variables.name: VM Disk
variables.description: Sparse qcow2 capacity in GiB. Alpine accepts 2 GiB; Ubuntu, Debian, AlmaLinux and Rocky require at least 8 GiB.

variables.name: VM Disk Compression
variables.description: QCOW2 compression used only during fresh installation. Zstd saves initial disk space but costs additional TCG CPU; changing it later requires a nonce-confirmed reset.

variables.name: VM Hostname
variables.description: Single-label Linux hostname used during first VM installation.

variables.name: Allowed Software
variables.description: ADMIN POLICY: comma-separated provider IDs.

variables.name: VM Maximum Memory
variables.description: ADMIN POLICY: maximum guest RAM in MB.

variables.name: VM Maximum CPUs
variables.description: ADMIN POLICY: maximum guest vCPUs.

variables.name: VM Maximum Disk
variables.description: ADMIN POLICY: maximum sparse VM disk size in GiB.

variables.name: Allow User Reset
variables.description: ADMIN POLICY: allow nonce-confirmed destructive switches.

variables.name: Brand Name
variables.description: ADMIN POLICY: console menu brand.

variables.name: Support URL
variables.description: ADMIN POLICY: optional support page.

variables.name: Runtime Mirror URL
variables.description: ADMIN POLICY: optional HTTPS mirror base URL.

variables.name: PCVM Cache Limit
variables.description: ADMIN POLICY: global PCVM download and runtime cache cap in MiB.

variables.name: Clear Console
variables.description: ADMIN POLICY: clear terminal screen and scrollback before pcvm run output.
